[SCENE: Location matches @Image1: A spacious, polished penthouse kitchen with warm evening light, pale stone counters, dark wood cabinetry and stainless-steel appliances. Its open layout connects visually to the penthouse entrance and leaves generous clear floor space.]
[CAST: CLAIRE is @Image2. ETHAN is @Image3. SLOANE is @Image4. Each named character's face, hair, and clothing match their reference image exactly: do not restyle or re-cast.]
[FRAME 0.0s OPENING POSE & BLOCKING: In the WHITMORE PENTHOUSE kitchen at evening, Claire stands at the stove stirring soup, her expression composed and eyes fixed on the pot. The front door has just slammed; Ethan stands in the kitchen entrance, broad shoulders squared and face cold, with Sloane just behind him wearing a faint, satisfied smile.]

[Hard cut to a low-angle medium close-up of Ethan in the kitchen entrance, jaw set as he addresses Claire; the front door’s slam echoes behind him, ETHAN speaking with animated lips:]
ETHAN (in Low, smooth, General American accent): (coldly, matter-of-fact) "Sloane is moving into the guest room."

[Whip cut down to Claire’s hand tightening around the ladle, then slowly loosening as soup turns beneath it; her face stays softly reflected in the pot, filmed close, while ETHAN's voice carries on off-camera. Nobody on screen speaks:]
ETHAN (off-screen, concluding line, in Low, smooth, General American accent): (coldly, dismissive) "Don’t make it awkward."
[Every mouth on screen stays strictly closed with lips firmly motionless; zero lip movement.]

[Tight close-up on Claire as she lifts her eyes from the soup, expression calm and unreadable, CLAIRE speaking with animated lips:]
CLAIRE (in Mid-range, clear, General American accent): (calmly) "Since when?"

[Over Claire’s shoulder, a measured push-in on Ethan as he holds her gaze without warmth, ETHAN speaking with animated lips:]
ETHAN (in Low, smooth, General American accent): (flatly) "Since I got tired of pretending."

[Rack focus from Ethan to Sloane behind him; Sloane watches Claire with a small, pleased smile, her mouth closed, SLOANE reacting with mouth strictly closed and lips motionless as ETHAN's voice carries on off-camera:]
ETHAN (off-screen, concluding line, in Low, smooth, General American accent): (flatly) "You just cook and nod."
[SLOANE keeps mouth strictly closed with lips firmly motionless; zero lip movement.]

[Close-up on Sloane leaning slightly into the kitchen light, red lips curving into an overly sweet smile, SLOANE speaking with animated lips:]
SLOANE (in Mid-high, lightly breathy, General American accent): (sweetly, with a taunting edge) "Sorry, Claire. Love finds a way."

[Slow push-in on Claire as she turns from the stove toward them, smoothing her expression into a gentle smile, CLAIRE speaking with animated lips:]
CLAIRE (in Mid-range, clear, General American accent): (softly, controlled) "Of course. I’ll make up the room."

[One unbroken extreme close-up on Claire’s face; her smile remains in place as her eyes sharpen with private resolve, lips closed. The camera holds this one framing for the whole of this inner thought, with no cut away until it ends. Mouth strictly closed, lips motionless:]
CLAIRE (V.O. - inner thought in Mid-range, clear, General American accent): (quiet, resolute inner thought) "Six months of playing broken. One more night, and he’ll never see it coming."
[CLAIRE keeps mouth strictly closed with lips pressed firmly together and motionless, showing how the thought lands only through eye movements and facial expression; zero lip movement.]

RAPID-FIRE PACING & LIP-SYNC DIRECTIVE: Dialogue plays in continuous, rapid-fire succession with instant syllable handoffs across cuts. ZERO pauses, silent breaks, or audio gaps between dialogue lines. Each line begins the instant the previous line finishes. Actions and camera moves happen concurrently while lines are actively spoken, and a camera cut never interrupts, restarts or repeats a line. Synchronize lip movement exclusively onto the active live speakers on camera (ETHAN, CLAIRE, SLOANE). During all (V.O. - inner thought) lines the camera stays locked on CLAIRE, whose mouth is strictly closed and lips completely stationary, reacting solely through eye movements and facial expression. CRITICAL OFF-SCREEN DIALOGUE & REACTION RULE: When the camera cuts, tracks, or frames a reacting character or prop while dialogue is actively concluding or spoken off-camera (L-cut reaction shots), on-screen characters MUST keep their mouths strictly closed with lips completely motionless. NEVER animate the lips or mouth of any character on screen to another character's voice, and do not alter the speaker's vocal timbre. Non-speaking listeners NEVER mouth off-screen dialogue. Fluid rapid-fire pacing throughout. No background music.
